title: Animal Behavior
coreMove: Ask what social payoff a useful behavior buys before accepting its surface function as the whole explanation.
sourcePressure: The source uses primate grooming and Arabian babbler helping to teach readers to separate a behavior's useful surface from its hidden social payoff.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The writer turns the animal examples into sneering proof that care and cooperation are fake.

sourceAnchors.name: primate social grooming
sourceAnchors.detail: The source says grooming looks hygienic but also functions as political alliance management among primates.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: A hand picking through fur can clean and campaign at the same time.

sourceAnchors.name: Arabian babbler competitive altruism
sourceAnchors.detail: The source says babbler helping can look group-serving while also working as prestige competition.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The bird on guard may be helping the flock and advertising itself in the same breath.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

exampleSpecs.audience: a volunteer coordinator learning to read animal care records socially
exampleSpecs.stakes: a misread dominance problem keeps disrupting introductions between rescued primates
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Sarah circles grooming entries that cluster after fights and beside higher-ranking animals, then changes the introduction plan around alliance tension rather than hygiene alone.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: The clipboard smells faintly of disinfectant beside a row of penciled grooming marks.
mustAvoid: cute animal care story with no status pattern

exampleSpecs.audience: a junior field assistant mapping cooperative behavior in a preserve
exampleSpecs.stakes: the team may mistake visible guarding for pure sacrifice and miss the prestige pattern
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Mathieu predicts the loudest helper will be safest from status conflict, then watches the same bird push into the most visible guard perch after feeding others.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Dry grass rattles under the hide before any person speaks.
mustAvoid: invented species behavior beyond the supported babbler anchor

exampleSpecs.audience: a coach trying to distinguish help from rank bids without punishing help
exampleSpecs.stakes: a generous player may be both useful and campaigning for captain
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: What if the player who carries every cone is also choosing the moment when every parent can see him?
exampleSpecs.firstImage: What if the player carrying the cones waits until the parents line the fence?

exampleSpecs.audience: a maintainer reviewing a sudden burst of helpful issue comments
exampleSpecs.stakes: a public helper could improve the project while maneuvering for commit access
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: It took Ingrid three weeks to notice that the most helpful comments appeared only on issues watched by the steering group, so she separates contribution value from status bid.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: It took Ingrid three weeks to see the pattern in the notification timestamps.

exampleSpecs.audience: a volunteer lead assigning visible and invisible tasks fairly
exampleSpecs.stakes: highly visible favors are crowding out less glamorous work patients need
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: "I can take the lobby shift again," Jack says, and the lead asks who stocked the quiet family room where no donors pass.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: "I can take the lobby shift again," Jack says before the schedule is even open.

exampleSpecs.audience: a director balancing real help and public credit
exampleSpecs.stakes: backstage labor is being neglected because the visible helpful roles carry prestige
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: You watch Sofia choose the prop table only after the cast list goes up, then assign public thanks to the invisible crew as well as the visible runners.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: You see the prop table empty under the stage lights before rehearsal starts.

skillTargets: distinguish surface function from social payoff in animal and human analogies
explain how useful behavior can still signal prestige
avoid the false choice between pure altruism and fraud

tryThisNowSpec: Pick one visible helpful act you saw today and write two columns: what it accomplished, and what standing or alliance signal it may also have sent.
